tex_content.label: sec:riemanns-problem
tex_content.source:
\label{sec:riemanns-problem}

Riemann's problem is
\[
(1)\qquad \mathbf u_t+\mathbf F(\mathbf u)_x=0
\quad\text{in }\mathbb R\times(0,\infty),
\qquad
(2)\qquad
\mathbf g(x)=
\begin{cases}
\mathbf u_l & x<0,\\
\mathbf u_r & x>0.
\end{cases}
\]
